newsitem.title: USA: U.S. housing starts down in March.
newsitem.headline: U.S. housing starts down in March.

text.p: Construction starts on new homes and apartments fell in March after a burst of activity during February, when exceptionally mild weather helped builders, the Commerce Department said on Wednesday.
Total starts declined 6.4 percent to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.43 million in March following a revised 10.7 percent surge in February to 1.52 million a year.
